content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for the Samagra Shiksha Korba recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 32 vacancies announced for the Part-time Yoga/Sports Instructor and Music Instructor positions in Samagra Shiksha Korba.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Part-time Yoga/Sports Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree in Yoga/Sports Education or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Part-time Music Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree in Music or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 10000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the preparation of a Merit List, Document Verification, and an Interview/Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Korba, Chhattisgarh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).
